findings: Exact native first-block skip and pool do not resolve the final-image mismatch in either view.
Full FP16 accumulation slightly improves the native-first-block diagnostic but worsens the independent reconstruction in both views.
The lower graph times with native first-block activations omit computing that block and are not deployable speedups.
First-frame logs show one global UAV barrier at each of 16 distinct chain positions. This does not justify a redundant-barrier removal patch.
limitations: Two first-reset views in one scene; no temporal or cross-scene quality acceptance.
Native measurements contain two sparse warm intervals per view; no native speedup is claimed.
Remaining network and final composition differences are not yet localized to one operation.
No binaries, model weights, raw captures, disassembly, private filesystem paths or device addresses are distributed.
